title: HR Manager (Clinical Operations & Talent Acquisition) - Boston Diabetes, Hyderabad
description: Boston Diabetes is looking for an experienced *HR Manager* with a strong background in hospitals or clinical healthcare settings to lead recruitment, manpower planning, and HR operations for our Hyderabad center. ### Key Responsibilities * Lead end-to-end recruitment for doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and clinical/non-clinical staff. * Prepare manpower plans to support business expansion. * Review and update Job Descriptions (JDs). * Develop and monitor KPIs and KRAs for all employees. * Ensure implementation of HR policies and SOPs. * Conduct onboarding, probation reviews, performance evaluations, and exit interviews. * Monitor employee performance and support department heads in improving productivity. * Coordinate with the US HR team for payroll documentation (attendance and payroll are centrally managed). * Build and scale high-performing teams as new centers are launched. ### Requirements * Minimum *6 years of HR experience, with at least **3 years in a hospital or clinical setup*. * Proven experience hiring doctors, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals. * Strong experience in recruitment, manpower planning, performance management, and HR operations. * Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills. * *Male candidates preferred.*
